title: Analista de BI
description:
Código da vaga: 57581


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência anterior em projetos de Governança de Dados ou BI;

- Capacidade de mapeamento de processos e documentação (BPMN);

- Forte visão analítica e habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em estruturas de dados;

- Conhecimento em gestão de metadados, glossário, linhagem e políticas de dados;

- Experiência com ferramentas de catálogo de dados (desejável: OpenMetadata);

- Conhecimento prático em SQL e Python;

- Familiaridade com ambientes AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, IAM);

- Noções de ETL/ELT e ferramentas como dbt, Airflow ou similares;

- Conhecimento em LGPD e boas práticas de segurança da informação;


O que será um diferencial?


- Familiaridade com DAMA DMBOK;

- Conhecimento em DataOps e automação de pipelines de dados;

- Certificações ou cursos em Governança de Dados, LGPD ou AWS;

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban);


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.


About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.


WHAT YOU WILL DO


Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment


End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.


Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

title: DevOps Automation Engineer – Database Platforms
description:

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract

Design implement and maintain infrastructure as code for database environments using Terraform

Build and manage CICD pipelines for database tools and platform deployments using GitHub Actions and Argo CD

Develop and maintain Helm charts for deploying database operators and internal services to Kubernetes

Write Python automation for provisioning patching backups secrets and compliance across platforms

Manage GitOps based Kubernetes deployments and environments using Argo CD

Implement and standardize secrets management integrations eg. Vault AWS Secrets Manager KMS

Integrate observability into database platforms eg Prometheus Grafana New Relic

Partner with DB engineers to support automated test environments mocking and validation tooling

Create and maintain internal tooling libraries templates and reusable modules

Produce and maintain documentation for workflows standards and L2 onboarding

Core Qualifications:

Infrastructure Cloud

Proficiency with Terraform for AWS andor multicloud infrastructure modular DRY design remote state

Strong understanding of cloud fundamentals IAM roles VPC networking EC2 storage monitoring KMS

Kubernetes Deployment Automation

Handson experience with Helm chart creation customization lifecycle management

Experience deploying and managing Kubernetes workloads StatefulSets PVCs RBAC node affinity

Proficient with Argo CD and GitOps principles for Kubernetes application delivery

Automation Tooling

Strong Python development skills for platform automation tool creation and libraries

Experience building and managing CICD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools

Familiarity with configuration and parameterization of database operators CNPG Percona Redis etc

Experience integrating secrets automation workflows with Vault External Secrets or similar tools

Observability Monitoring

Experience integrating tools such as Prometheus Grafana New Relic and custom exporters

Understanding of SLOSLAdriven alerting and metrics pipelines

Operational Excellence

Ability to translate infrastructure and platform needs into scalable code

Comfortable creating documentation onboarding guides and reusable templates

Effective communicator able to collaborate with DB engineers SREs and platform teams

Ownership mindset deliver solutions endtoend proactively identify gaps and lead improvements

Bonus Skills:

Familiarity with PostgreSQL MySQL MongoDB Redis or other database platforms

Experience managing Kubernetes Operators for databases

Experience with secrets management via Vault Agent or External Secrets Operator

Exposure to load testing frameworks or validation tooling for infrastructure components

Experience supporting internal developer platforms or selfservice tooling layers

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

Junte-se a nós!

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:

  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment

  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.

  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS

  • applications

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule

title: React Developer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a React Developer to join our Reinforcement Learning (RL) Gym project. You will be responsible for building and maintaining intuitive, high-performance web interfaces that enable researchers and engineers to visualize, interact with, and manage reinforcement learning workflows. This role requires strong React expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with backend and ML teams to deliver seamless user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and libraries to support experimentation workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure smooth data flow.
  • Work with engineers and researchers to create visualizations for training, evaluation, and benchmarking results.
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Ensure high code quality with testing, reviews, and adherence to best practices.
  • Troubleshoot issues, debug code, and contribute to continuous improvements in the frontend stack.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on React.
  • Solid understanding of JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience with state management libraries
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks
  • Understanding of build tools and CI/CD workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
  • Good to have: Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or exposure to ML/AI project interfaces.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.


Important Notes for Submission

  • Kindly prioritize candidates with immediate availability and confirm their commitment to 8 - 4 hrs/day with PST overlap.


Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: Full-time (8 hours/day). At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with an overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location: India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt, Ghana, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Mexico.


Evaluation Process

  • Candidates complete Interest Check Form (ICF)
  • Shortlisted candidates only will be invited for MTI

title: \"Data Engineer #992594\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto de uma multinacional global de grande porte , referência nos segmentos de bens de consumo e tecnologia , com operações em diversos países e forte maturidade em dados, analytics e plataformas em nuvem .

O projeto está inserido em um contexto corporativo e global , apoiando áreas técnicas e de negócio na garantia da qualidade, disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos dados , com impacto direto em reporting e tomada de decisão estratégica.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no suporte técnico de plataformas de dados e soluções de reporting
  • Investigar e resolver problemas relacionados a dados em ambientes SQL Server e Azure
  • Escrever, otimizar e dar suporte a queries SQL/T-SQL, views e stored procedures
  • Monitorar ambientes Microsoft SQL Server, garantindo integridade, performance e disponibilidade
  • Apoiar e solucionar falhas em pipelines e integrações no Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Realizar análises e validações de dados para identificar inconsistências e problemas de qualidade
  • Apoiar a resolução de incidentes, análise de causa raiz e documentação técnica
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de Data Engineering, Analytics e stakeholders de negócio

O que você precisa ter

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e T-SQL
  • Experiência prática com Microsoft SQL Server
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Forte capacidade de análise de dados e atenção a detalhes
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e bancos de dados relacionais
  • Vivência em troubleshooting de ambientes produtivos
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em Python para automação, scripts ou análise de dados
  • Noções de Data Science (estatística, exploração de dados, modelos simples)
  • Experiência com processos de ETL e pipelines de dados
  • Familiaridade com Power BI ou outras ferramentas de BI
  • Conhecimento em Power Apps


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.


What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .

title: 3D Architectural Visualization Artist (Unreal Engine)
description:
Company Description

Clay is an immersive operating system designed to modernize real estate development, leasing, and marketing processes for multifamily and single-family rental developers. By integrating 3D visualization, AI-driven sales tools, and behavioral insights, Clay centralizes operations and enhances personalized experiences for renters and buyers. The platform supports property teams in lead generation, virtual walkthroughs, and improving conversion rates with a streamlined leasing process. Clay collaborates with innovative real estate developers and operators across North America to improve the way communities are launched, leased, and scaled.


Role Description

We’re looking for a 3D Architectural Visualization Artist with strong Unreal Engine experience to help us create real-time interior apartment walkthroughs. This is not game development. Our work focuses on residential interiors used for sales and marketing.


Our pipeline combines AI-assisted modeling, Blender, Adobe Substance, and Unreal Engine, along with internal tools that automate floor plans and layouts. You’ll be trained on our internal tooling.


Our Workflow

  • Interior geometry is created using AI tools and/or manual modeling in Blender
  • Materials and textures are authored in Adobe Substance (Painter/Designer)
  • Scenes are assembled, lit, and optimized in Unreal Engine (UE5)
  • Internal Unreal-connected tools help generate floor plans and unit layouts → Full training provided


Experience working in structured pipelines is important. You will ensure the delivery of visually compelling content, maintain accuracy in architectural representation, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring designs to life. Proficiency in Unreal Engine will be a crucial aspect of daily tasks.


Qualifications

  • Create high-quality interior apartment scenes in Unreal Engine
  • Work with AI-generated and hand-modeled assets
  • Author and apply realistic PBR materials using Adobe Substance
  • Set up interior lighting (Lumen, reflections, exposure)
  • Build clean, optimized real-time walkthroughs
  • Maintain visual consistency across multiple units and projects
  • Learn and use internal tools connected to Unreal Engine


Requirements

Must-have

  • Strong experience with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred)
  • Architectural visualization experience (interiors required)
  • Proficiency in Blender or similar DCC tools
  • Experience with Adobe Substance for materials/textures
  • Solid understanding of real-time lighting and performance optimization
  • Portfolio showing Unreal Engine interior walkthroughs


Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with AI-assisted modeling workflows
  • Datasmith workflow experience
  • Apartment or residential interior projects
  • Basic Blueprint knowledge
  • Experience working with internal or proprietary tools

Essa é uma posição 100% focada em prospecção ativa : identificar oportunidades onde ainda não existe relacionamento, gerar demanda de forma estratégica e transformar leads frios em reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendas.

Aqui, você não vai esperar leads prontos.

A Velana é um gateway de pagamentos digital em crescimento acelerado, conectando e-commerces, plataformas e infoprodutores a soluções de pagamento seguras, escaláveis e eficientes.

Nosso crescimento é impulsionado por tecnologia, estratégia comercial e um time de hunters que sabem onde atacar e como converter.

  • Atuar em parceria com Marketing para melhorar listas, segmentações e cadências.

  • Uso de ferramentas como Lusha, Apollo, Sales Navigator e CRM;
  • Comunicação clara, persuasiva e estratégica;
  • Organização para seguir cadências e metas de prospecção;

Preferencialmente residir em São Paulo ou região (eliminatório).


O que Oferecemos

  • Papel estratégico e protagonista no crescimento da Velana;
  • Autonomia total para testar abordagens e construir pipeline;
  • Ambiente rápido, direto e sem burocracia;
  • Contratação PJ | 100% remoto;
  • Bônus por performance;
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento em uma fintech em expansão.



Por que a Velana?

Na Velana, o time de prospecção é o motor que impulsiona nosso crescimento. Você não será apenas mais um buscando leads, mas sim um vendedor estratégico que identifica possibilidades e tem autonomia para expandir de forma exponencial a nossa base.


Candidate-se e vamos crescer juntos!

  • 100% Remoto | PJ | Bônus por performance

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

£70,000 - £90,000

Remote - Brazil (You will need to work UK time zone)


You already know how to build software that works.


What you might be missing is the chance to build something that matters, where the details count and the users notice when you get it right.


This role is for an engineer who cares how things look, how they behave, and how they hold up when real money and real users are involved.


Why you’ll love it here:

  • You’ll own real parts of the product, not just tickets
  • The UI has to be precise and trusted, not “close enough”
  • You’ll work across the full stack with real influence over decisions
  • The product sits between traditional finance expectations and onchain systems
  • You’ll build for institutional and high net worth users who demand clarity and reliability


Who this isn’t for:

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a narrow remit, loose UI standards, or to ship features without thinking end to end.


If you prefer clear tickets, minimal ownership, or letting AI do the thinking for you, this will feel uncomfortable.


Day to day:

You’ll be building and refining a production platform used to manage onchain assets.


That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.


The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.


Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.


The Business:

The business is a FinTech fund building onchain banking infrastructure for institutional capital.

It operates where stablecoins, DeFi lending, automation, and risk management meet.


The focus is usability and trust, bringing institutional-grade expectations into onchain finance, with active engagement from major financial institutions.


Requirements:

  • Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Proven ability to ship precise, production-quality UI
  • Solid SQL knowledge with Postgres and an ORM such as Prisma
  • Experience designing APIs and backend workflows, including orchestration tools like Temporal
  • Understanding of ERC-4626 and DeFi lending markets such as Aave or Morpho
  • Confident, structured use of LLM tools like Cursor or Claude Code
  • FinTech experience preferred
  • Able to travel freely across Europe


If you want ownership, technical breadth, and the chance to build a mature system people genuinely rely on, this is worth a conversation.

That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.


The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.


Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.


The Business:

The business is a FinTech fund building onchain banking infrastructure for institutional capital.

It operates where stablecoins, DeFi lending, automation, and risk management meet.


The focus is usability and trust, bringing institutional-grade expectations into onchain finance, with active engagement from major financial institutions.


Requirements:

  • Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Proven ability to ship precise, production-quality UI
  • Solid SQL knowledge with Postgres and an ORM such as Prisma
  • Experience designing APIs and backend workflows, including orchestration tools like Temporal
  • Understanding of ERC-4626 and DeFi lending markets such as Aave or Morpho
  • Confident, structured use of LLM tools like Cursor or Claude Code
  • FinTech experience preferred
  • Able to travel freely across Europe


If you want ownership, technical breadth, and the chance to build a mature system people genuinely rely on, this is worth a conversation.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the \"Control Room\" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \"Visualizations\" and that the \"Data Pipelines\" are reliably deployed by DevOps.


What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The \"Expert\": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.


Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.


Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud


Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Senior Splunk Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).
  • Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
  • Automate SOP-based operational workflows.


5. Transition

  • Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
  • Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
  • Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.


Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
  • Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
  • Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
  • Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.



Certifications (required)

Minimum two of:

  • Splunk Core Certified User
  • Splunk Core Certified Power User
  • Splunk Enterprise Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Architect
  • Optional: Splunk ES


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication in enterprise environments.
  • Clear documentation skills.
  • Proactive, quality-driven work style.
  • Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant (Remote, Brazil)


We are looking for a Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant to join a global project, working 100 percent remotely from Brazil . This role is for someone with real hands on experience in SAP Fieldglass implementations , not generic SAP consulting.


If you have worked deeply with Fieldglass CWM and SOW , understand Source to Pay , and are comfortable working directly with clients, this role is for you.


What You Will Do

  • Work on SAP Fieldglass implementation and rollout projects
  • Configure and support Contingent Workforce Management (CWM) and Statement of Work (SOW) processes
  • Collaborate with procurement, HR, finance, and IT stakeholders
  • Support integrations between SAP Fieldglass and SAP Ariba, SAP S 4HANA, or SAP ECC
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into Fieldglass configuration
  • Identify risks early and propose clear mitigation actions
  • Support testing, defect resolution, and UAT activities using JIRA
  • Ensure high quality delivery with strong focus on customer satisfaction

Mandatory Experience

  • 6 or more years of hands on experience with SAP Fieldglass
  • Proven experience in Fieldglass implementation or rollout projects
  • Strong configuration experience in CWM and SOW
  • Solid understanding of Source to Pay processes
  • Experience integrating Fieldglass with SAP Ariba and SAP S 4HANA or SAP ECC
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP SuccessFactors
  • Previous work in global or multi country projects
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills

Work Setup

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work model: 100 percent remote
  • Client interview required
  • English is mandatory for daily communication

Important

  • Resumes must be submitted in English
  • This role requires real SAP Fieldglass project experience
  • Candidates without Fieldglass hands on experience will not be considered

title: Arquiteto de Soluções (Remoto | Temporário)
description:
Remoto, com viagens mensais (3 a 4 dias, Uberlândia - MG)

Tempo de alocação: 6 meses

Contratação: CLT



Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico focado na avaliação, desenho e recomendação de uma nova arquitetura de infraestrutura em substituição ao ambiente OpenStack atualmente utilizado.


Este profissional terá atuação agnóstica, avaliando diferentes alternativas de mercado (nuvem pública, plataformas privadas, virtualização tradicional e soluções hyperconvergentes ) e recomendando a opção com o melhor custo/benefício, alinhada às necessidades técnicas e de negócio do cliente.


A atuação será estritamente consultiva e arquitetural; atividades de execução serão direcionadas pelas equipes técnicas do cliente.


O profissional será responsável por interagir diretamente com times técnicos e também apresentar resultados e recomendações ao Diretor de Engenharia, exigindo excelente comunicação, clareza técnica e postura executiva.


Responsabilidades

  • Avaliar o ambiente OpenStack atual , incluindo arquitetura, componentes, integrações e custos operacionais.
  • Mapear requisitos técnicos, de negócio, compliance e governança do cliente.
  • Pesquisar, comparar e recomendar alternativas de migração tais como:
  • Plataformas de virtualização tradicionais (VMware, Proxmox, etc.)
  • Soluções HCI (Nutanix, Azure Stack HCI, etc.)
  • Nuvens públicas (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Outras distribuições OpenStack suportadas comercialmente
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de referência, desenhos de alto nível (HLD), roadmap de migração e análise de custos.
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas e executivas, apresentando estudos, opções e recomendações.
  • Garantir que qualquer intervenção técnica necessária seja executada apenas mediante orientação do arquiteto.
  • Preparar documentação clara e estruturada, incluindo relatórios de avaliação, comparativos e recomendações finais.
  • Atuar como trusted advisor, mantendo postura neutra e isenta de direcionamento a fabricante específico.


Requerimentos

  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto Cloud ou Arquiteto de Infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento sólido em OpenStack : arquitetura, componentes (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, etc.) , modelos de implantação e operação.
  • Experiência com pelo menos duas alternativas de virtualização ou nuvem, como:
  • VMware vSphere
  • Proxmox
  • Nutanix
  • Azure, AWS ou GCP
  • Capacidade de realizar análises comparativas técnicas, financeiras e operacionais.
  • Experiência em desenho de arquiteturas, modelos de alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e continuidade de negócios.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para apresentar resultados e recomendações para nível diretivo.
  • Forte capacidade de condução de workshops, entrevistas técnicas e apresentações executivas.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Certificações relacionadas a arquitetura ou nuvem (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Architect, Nutanix NCA/NCP, OpenStack COA, TOGAF, etc.).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de OpenStack.
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e estratégia multicloud.
  • Conhecimento em containers, Kubernetes ou plataformas de virtualização moderna.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e carrega quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente a partir da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em projetos de dados e analytics, apoiando áreas de negócio com soluções de integração, governança e Business Intelligence
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de Data Integration e ETL/ELT, preferencialmente utilizando plataformas Microsoft (SSIS ou Azure)
  • Modelar dados e construir pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis para ambientes analíticos
  • Criar, manter e otimizar stored procedures em Snowflake
  • Realizar análises avançadas em SQL, incluindo queries complexas, performance tuning e modelagem de dados
  • Atuar na construção de soluções de Business Intelligence utilizando Power BI, SSRS, SSAS e/ou Tableau
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas de Data Pipeline e Analytics em ambientes cloud (Azure ou AWS)
  • Garantir boas práticas de data governance, qualidade de dados e aderência a padrões da indústria
  • Colaborar com times técnicos e de negócio, atuando em ambiente global com comunicação constante em inglês
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica e comunicação clara sobre soluções de dados


O que você precisa ter

  • Sólido conhecimento em bancos de dados, modelagem de dados e SQL
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções de Data Integration e ETL/ELT
  • Vivência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, SSRS, SSAS e/ou Tableau)
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação, com preferência por Python
  • Conhecimento em fundamentos de cloud computing (Azure ou AWS)
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de Data Pipeline e Analytics
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação escrita e verbal em ambiente global
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, organização e trabalho colaborativo


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com Snowflake
  • Vivência com Azure Data Factory
  • Experiência com JavaScript em alto nível
  • Conhecimento em dbt, incluindo criação de modelos, macros e regras de qualidade de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas Collibra Data Quality e Collibra Data Governance
  • Vivência na criação e consumo de APIs
  • Conhecimento em BODS
  • Fundamentos de DevOps


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office.

Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, entregando serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, evolução de soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, inclusão e equidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter talentos, criando conexões reais e duradouras.

Acreditamos que a combinação certa entre talento, tecnologia e organizações desbloqueia resultados transformadores e impulsiona o sucesso de clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em projetos de dados e analytics, apoiando áreas de negócio com soluções de integração, governança e Business Intelligence
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de Data Integration e ETL/ELT, preferencialmente utilizando plataformas Microsoft (SSIS ou Azure)
  • Modelar dados e construir pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis para ambientes analíticos
  • Criar, manter e otimizar stored procedures em Snowflake
  • Realizar análises avançadas em SQL, incluindo queries complexas, performance tuning e modelagem de dados
  • Atuar na construção de soluções de Business Intelligence utilizando Power BI, SSRS, SSAS e/ou Tableau
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas de Data Pipeline e Analytics em ambientes cloud (Azure ou AWS)
  • Garantir boas práticas de data governance, qualidade de dados e aderência a padrões da indústria
  • Colaborar com times técnicos e de negócio, atuando em ambiente global com comunicação constante em inglês
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica e comunicação clara sobre soluções de dados


O que você precisa ter

  • Sólido conhecimento em bancos de dados, modelagem de dados e SQL
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções de Data Integration e ETL/ELT
  • Vivência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, SSRS, SSAS e/ou Tableau)
  • Experiência com linguagens de programação, com preferência por Python
  • Conhecimento em fundamentos de cloud computing (Azure ou AWS)

  • Inglês fluente para comunicação escrita e verbal em ambiente global
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação, organização e trabalho colaborativo


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Conhecimento em dbt, incluindo criação de modelos, macros e regras de qualidade de dados

Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. BRQ WAY

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Full Stack Java/Angular - SR, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?

Desenvolvimento Backend e Arquitetura

  • Java 8+, Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring, construção de APIs seguras e escaláveis, microsserviços, APIs REST, mensageria, arquiteturas distribuídas, Clean Architecture, SOLID, DDD e Design Patterns.

Bancos de Dados e Performance

  • Modelagem e otimização em bancos relacionais (SQL), queries complexas e atuação com NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra).

Desenvolvimento Frontend

  • Angular 11+, TypeScript, RxJS, construção de SPAs, componentização, serviços, roteamento, lazy loading, HTML5, CSS3, Sass/Less, foco em performance, acessibilidade e experiência do usuário.

Qualidade de Software e Boas Práticas de Engenharia

DevOps, Cloud e Observabilidade

- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions
