title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes , nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.


É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
  • Construir e conduzir planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
  • Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco.

Relacionamento Consultivo

  • Ser a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
  • Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
  • Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução.

Operação & Execução

  • Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
  • Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades.

Cultura de Cliente

  • Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
  • Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
  • Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
  • Conhecimento básico a intermediário de métricas SaaS (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
  • Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;
  • Habilidade e disponibilidade para visita em grandes clientes.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS B2B;
  • Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
  • Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
  • Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: WbD, Success Playbooks).


Diferenciais

  • Atuação prévia em empresas com foco em reputação, comunicação, PRTech ou martech;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (McKinsey, Bain, BCG);
  • Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
  • Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
  • Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.

title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética I
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar diagnósticos energéticos nas unidades operacionais, identificando oportunidades de otimização do consumo e melhoria de performance.
  • Desenvolver e implantar projetos de eficiência energética, incluindo análises técnicas e financeiras (payback, VPL, TIR).
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de consumo e desempenho energético, assegurando acompanhamento sistemático dos resultados.
  • Propor e implementar soluções de automação, controle e melhoria de processos, especialmente em sistemas de bombeamento, motores e acionamentos.
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade para fontes alternativas de energia (solar, biogás, PCH), apoiando decisões técnicas e econômicas.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as áreas de operação e manutenção, além de conduzir treinamentos, certificações e iniciativas de melhoria contínua em eficiência energética.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica, de Produção, Controle e Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em Eficiência Energética, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais, saneamento ou operações com sistemas de bombeamento e motores.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas de bombeamento, motores elétricos e dispositivos de acionamento, como soft-starters e inversores de frequência.
  • Noções de diagnóstico energético e hidroenergético (levantamento de dados, medições, baseline e verificação de resultados).
  • Domínio de Excel para organização e análise de dados e PowerPoint para apresentações; Power BI como diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens às unidades de negócio, conforme a necessidade dos projetos/operações.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Engenheiro de software sênior .NET
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Location : Brazil (Remote opportunity)


Join our team and start a new adventure in an international, dynamic, and highly regulated environment, where you can grow your career within a rapidly expanding organization.

Being a consultant at Amaris Consulting means positioning yourself as a technical and functional reference in Regulatory Affairs , acting as a strategic partner to our clients thanks to:

  • Your leadership and communication skills , enabling you to build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Your critical and regulatory mindset , allowing you to anticipate risks and propose solutions aligned with current regulations.
  • Your curiosity and continuous learning , supporting clients across multiple industries in complex regulatory contexts.

Your missions

  • Lead Regulatory Affairs activities for medical devices , ensuring compliance with European regulations (EU MDR – Regulation (EU) 2017/745).
  • Act as an expert in medical device classification , with a focus on Class IIa and IIb , ensuring correct application of classification rules.
  • Coordinate the preparation, review, and maintenance of technical documentation (EU MDR Annexes II and III).
  • Provide expert support in CE Marking processes and conformity assessments , including direct interaction with Notified Bodies .
  • Analyze and manage regulatory changes , assessing their impact on the product portfolio and defining regulatory strategies.
  • Advise quality, clinical, R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain teams on regulatory matters throughout the device lifecycle.
  • Lead responses to observations, questions, and non-conformities raised by health authorities and Notified Bodies.
  • Ensure compliance with post-market requirements , when applicable (PMS, PMCF, vigilance).
  • Propose and lead improvements in regulatory processes , optimizing timelines, documentation quality, and compliance.

Your profile

  • 6+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs for medical devices.
  • Proven experience with European regulations (EU MDR) .
  • Strong expertise in Class IIa and IIb medical devices .
  • Experience working with Notified Bodies and health authorities .
  • Solid knowledge of the regulatory lifecycle of medical devices (registration, maintenance, changes, and post-market activities).
  • Academic background in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Health Sciences , or a related field.
  • Advanced / fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and prioritization skills .
  • Leadership, autonomy, and stakeholder management skills in international environments.


Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to diversity and to creating an inclusive work environment. We welcome all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes. Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.   • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow
description:
Desenvolvedor (a) Service Now

Atuação Remota

Contratação CLT

O Especialista em ServiceNow será responsável por gerenciar todas as atividades relacionadas à melhoria contínua da plataforma ServiceNow, atuando tanto na administração diária quanto na implementação de pequenas melhorias e desenvolvimentos. Este profissional deve ter um conhecimento amplo do software, abrangendo seus principais módulos e funcionalidades, além de experiência em UX para melhorar a experiência dos usuários finais. Também será capaz de evangelizar o uso da plataforma na organização, promovendo as melhores práticas e o engajamento dos usuários.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e liderar as melhorias contínuas da plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo a maximização de seu uso.
  • Desenvolver pequenas melhorias e personalizações na plataforma, de acordo com as necessidades do negócio e conforme as boas práticas recomendadas.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para a administração diária do ServiceNow, incluindo a resolução de incidentes, requisições de serviço e suporte ao usuário.
  • Realizar análise de processos para identificar oportunidades de automação e otimização dentro da ferramenta.
  • Promover a adoção dos módulos contratados da plataforma, realizando a gestão de stakeholders e o suporte aos usuários.
  • Fornecer orientações sobre o uso adequado do ServiceNow, definindo padrões, processos e promovendo a cultura de uso da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções com foco na experiência do usuário (UX), garantindo que as interfaces sejam intuitivas, eficientes e acessíveis.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de TI e de negócios para entender e traduzir as necessidades e requisitos para soluções dentro do ServiceNow.
  • Atuar na manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e na melhoria contínua da experiência dos usuários finais.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de melhoria e novas implementações da plataforma, assegurando a entrega de soluções eficazes e eficientes.


Requisitos Técnicos e de Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada com a administração e desenvolvimento de melhorias na plataforma ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos principais módulos do ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, CSM, HR Service Delivery, etc.).
  • Habilidade em desenvolver pequenas personalizações, scripts e integrações dentro do ServiceNow.
  • Experiência com a definição e implementação de processos ITIL e boas práticas dentro da plataforma.
  • Experiência em design centrado no usuário (UX/UI) e na criação de interfaces de usuário intuitivas e eficientes no ServiceNow.
  • Capacidade de analisar processos de negócios e traduzi-los em fluxos de trabalho eficientes no ServiceNow.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (como Scrum ou Kanban) é um diferencial.
  • Certificações ServiceNow (como Certified System Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist) são desejáveis.

title: Analista tributário

title: Sourcer Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM e Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Required Skills & Qualifications:

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Location : Brazil (Remote opportunity)


Join our team and start a new adventure in an international, dynamic, and highly regulated environment, where you can grow your career within a rapidly expanding organization.

Being a consultant at Amaris Consulting means positioning yourself as a technical and functional reference in Regulatory Affairs , acting as a strategic partner to our clients thanks to:

  • Your leadership and communication skills , enabling you to build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Your critical and regulatory mindset , allowing you to anticipate risks and propose solutions aligned with current regulations.
  • Your curiosity and continuous learning , supporting clients across multiple industries in complex regulatory contexts.

Your missions

  • Lead Regulatory Affairs activities for medical devices , ensuring compliance with European regulations (EU MDR – Regulation (EU) 2017/745).
  • Act as an expert in medical device classification , with a focus on Class IIa and IIb , ensuring correct application of classification rules.
  • Coordinate the preparation, review, and maintenance of technical documentation (EU MDR Annexes II and III).
  • Provide expert support in CE Marking processes and conformity assessments , including direct interaction with Notified Bodies .
  • Analyze and manage regulatory changes , assessing their impact on the product portfolio and defining regulatory strategies.
  • Advise quality, clinical, R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain teams on regulatory matters throughout the device lifecycle.
  • Lead responses to observations, questions, and non-conformities raised by health authorities and Notified Bodies.
  • Ensure compliance with post-market requirements , when applicable (PMS, PMCF, vigilance).
  • Propose and lead improvements in regulatory processes , optimizing timelines, documentation quality, and compliance.

Your profile

  • 6+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs for medical devices.
  • Proven experience with European regulations (EU MDR) .
  • Strong expertise in Class IIa and IIb medical devices .
  • Experience working with Notified Bodies and health authorities .
  • Solid knowledge of the regulatory lifecycle of medical devices (registration, maintenance, changes, and post-market activities).
  • Academic background in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Health Sciences , or a related field.
  • Advanced / fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and prioritization skills .
  • Leadership, autonomy, and stakeholder management skills in international environments.


Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to diversity and to creating an inclusive work environment. We welcome all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic.

title: Oracle Business System Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Oracle Fusion who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

We are seeking an Oracle Business Systems Analyst (BSA), with functional experience with Oracle ERP Cloud, Supply Chain processes and Oracle GTM (Global Trade Management) module. Optionally, also have experience with both of the Order to Cash and Procure to Pay business processes and modules including (but not limited to): AP, AR, G/L, Cash Management, Order Management, and Inventory. This BSA will help define the integration of our GTM Application with Oracle products. Our ONESOURCE Integrations for Oracle is a key component of our product suite. As an Oracle BSA, he will be responsible for developing functional requirement, API mapping specs, test cases plans, validating acceptance criteria and documentation, as related to the integration processes between Oracle and ONESOURCE Global Trade.



Tasks Performed :


• Work closely with customers, prospects and Product Management in setting the direction of current and future the ONESOURCE Global Trade Integration for Oracle as well as helping to continue to maintain ONESOURCE Global Trade integration for Oracle competitive differentiation.


• Perform detailed analysis of ONSOURCE business integration with Oracle modules, primarily GTM to determine opportunities to strengthen and expand integration design.


• Prepare detailed Oracle Integration Requirement Specs & Functional Documentation with associated use cases, Define interface mapping rules, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements to Development, support teams, partners and customers.


• Demonstrate the ability to research and understand Oracle Fusion APIs.


• Perform feature validation of functionality, QA in test script creation and automation, and assist with end-user documentation


• Perform Oracle application configuration settings and options for relevant modules


• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Support and Professional Services staff



Essential Functions:


• Maintain a working relationship with internal customers including Product Development, Professional Services, Customer Advocacy, as well as Oracle via the Oracle Partner Program


• Gather, define and document Oracle business requirements


• Work closely with application developers, other BSA’s and QA testers throughout the entire product life cycle


• Participate in customer calls, visits and meetings to gather requirements and resolve issues


• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to partner domain experts. Follow product into the field to ensure customer success.


• Support current products, including 2nd level support analysis, patch assessment, and work-around investigation


• Provide business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.



Desired Job Experience:


• Requires a minimum of 1-3 years functional experience in key Oracle modules (Supply Chain Management and GTM), including requirements gathering, design, configuration, unit testing and integration testing.


• Experience with a full life cycle Oracle implementations


• Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) required


• Strong analytical, design and documentation skills


• Oracle design, configuration and hands on experience


• Exposure to broad financial processes and systems experience across quote-to-cash and procure-to-pay business functions (billing, order management, accounts receivable, purchasing, accounts payable, general ledger.)


• Experience with standard financial processes and ability to overlay the process understanding onto multiple financial business systems packages.


• Previous experience working in a software company strongly desired.


• Desirable experience in Oracle modules AP, AR, G/L, Order Management and Purchasing .


• Previous work with Oracle R12 EBS is a plus


• Experience with ONESOURCE Global Trade will be a plus



Other Qualifications:


• Excellent communication and presentation skills in interacting with management and communicating functional vision to both internal and external constituencies


• Strong customer-facing experience and skills.


• Experience with Agile Product Delivery Process , specifically Scrum is a plus


• Strong communication and presentation skills


• Technical/ Oracle development experience (Foundation, SQL*Plus, System Administration) is a plus


• Technical experience working with APIs (SOAP and REST) and API tools, such as SoapUi and Postman is a plus


• Ability to multi-task and work under tight deadlines in a fast paced environment

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
